detail.longDescription:
Are you looking for the ultimate All Document Reader and a smart PDF Editor to boost your productivity? You’ve found the right app! 

Experience seamless document management with our integrated file viewer. Whether you need to process business records, sign contracts, or leisurely read an eBook, our app is your all-in-one Document Viewer and PDF Scanner. Handle PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and EPUB files effortlessly in one secure place!

🚀 CORE FEATURES & TOOLS:

🤖 Smart AI PDF Assistant
• AI Summary: Tired of reading long reports? Our built-in AI quickly extracts highlights and generates an accurate document summary with just one click.
• Work Efficiently: Understand complex PDF documents in seconds. 

📚 Universal All Document Viewer
• Office Files: A reliable Word viewer, Excel reader, and PowerPoint viewer. Open DOCX, check XLSX sheets, and view PPTX slides smoothly.
• Ebook Reader: Enjoy reading novels? We fully support eBook reading as a dedicated EPUB reader. Switch easily between horizontal and vertical viewing modes.

📝 Advanced PDF Editor & E-Sign
• Edit & Annotate: Easily highlight text and take notes while reading.
• Fill & Sign: Need to sign a contract? Effortlessly fill PDF forms and easily add your e-signature directly from your phone. 

📷 Powerful PDF Scanner
• Scan to PDF: Turn your phone camera into a portable document scanner. Snap a photo and instantly convert receipts or notes into a high-quality PDF.
• Image to PDF: Easily convert existing photos or screenshots into professional PDF files. 

🔄 PDF Management & Security
• Merge & Split: Flexibly merge PDF files into a single document, or split PDF pages to keep only what you need.
• Password Protect: Keep your privacy intact. Quickly encrypt and lock PDF files, or unlock and remove passwords for easy sharing.

🗂️ Smart File Manager
• Auto-Sorting: Automatically categorizes files by format (Word, Excel, PPT, PDF).
• Easy Search: Locate your target files efficiently across your internal folder structure. 
• Offline Access: Unlike other tools, enjoy a fast offline document reader without needing an internet connection.

📁 SUPPORTED FORMATS:
• Word Document: DOC, DOCX
• Excel Spreadsheet: XLS, XLSX
• PowerPoint Presentation: PPT, PPTX
• EBook: EPUB
• Digital Documents: PDF

Join millions of satisfied users and revolutionize your workflow. Whether for professional office work or personal study, our All Document Reader is the only app you will ever need.

Download now to master your digital workspace!
